request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBTRN02C-004: Reject transaction received after account expiration (overwrites an over-limit reason)

### given[0]: The account record was found, and the over-limit check has already run, whatever its result.
fields=['ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT', 'WS-TEMP-BAL', 'ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
   406 
>> 407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
>> 408                   CONTINUE
>> 409                 ELSE
>> 410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
>> 412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 413                 END-IF
>> 414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
   415                   CONTINUE
   416                 ELSE
   417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'

### given[1]: The account expiration date is a 10-character text field.
fields=['ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE'] literals=[]
CVACT01Y.cpy:
     7            05  ACCT-CURR-BAL                     PIC S9(10)V99.
     8            05  ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT                 PIC S9(10)V99.
     9            05  ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT            PIC S9(10)V99.
    10            05  ACCT-OPEN-DATE                    PIC X(10).
>>  11            05  ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE               PIC X(10).
    12            05  ACCT-REISSUE-DATE                 PIC X(10).
    13            05  ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT              PIC S9(10)V99.
    14            05  ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT               PIC S9(10)V99.
    15            05  ACCT-ADDR-ZIP                     PIC X(10).

### given[2]: The transaction's original timestamp is a 26-character text field. Only its first 10 characters (the date part) are compared.
fields=['DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS'] literals=[]
CVTRA06Y.cpy:
    12            05  DALYTRAN-MERCHANT-NAME                  PIC X(50).
    13            05  DALYTRAN-MERCHANT-CITY                  PIC X(50).
    14            05  DALYTRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP                   PIC X(10).
    15            05  DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM                       PIC X(16).
>>  16            05  DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS                        PIC X(26).
    17            05  DALYTRAN-PROC-TS                        PIC X(26).
    18            05  FILLER                                  PIC X(20).
    19       *
    20       * Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:16:01 CDT

### given[3]: The account record has an active-status field, but validation never checks it.
fields=['ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS'] literals=[]
CVACT01Y.cpy:
     2       *    Data-structure for  account entity (RECLN 300)
     3       *****************************************************************
     4        01  ACCOUNT-RECORD.
     5            05  ACCT-ID                           PIC 9(11).
>>   6            05  ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS                PIC X(01).
     7            05  ACCT-CURR-BAL                     PIC S9(10)V99.
     8            05  ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT                 PIC S9(10)V99.
     9            05  ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT            PIC S9(10)V99.
    10            05  ACCT-OPEN-DATE                    PIC X(10).

### when[0]: The expiration date is less than the first 10 characters of the original timestamp in a plain character comparison. If it is equal to or greater, this check passes.
fields=['ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE', 'DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
   412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   413                 END-IF
>> 414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
>> 415                   CONTINUE
>> 416                 ELSE
   417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
   419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   420                 END-IF

### then[0]: The fail reason is set to 103. This replaces 102 if the over-limit check also failed.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON'] literals=['103']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   413                 END-IF
   414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
   415                   CONTINUE
   416                 ELSE
>> 417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
   419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   420                 END-IF
   421            END-READ

### then[1]: The reason description is set to 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'. This replaces 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION' if it was set.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=['TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
   415                   CONTINUE
   416                 ELSE
   417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
>> 419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   420                 END-IF
   421            END-READ
   422            EXIT.
   423       *---------------------------------------------------------------*

### then[2]: The transaction is not posted. The reject count goes up by 1 and a reject record is written.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-REJECT-COUNT'] literals=['0', '1']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
   208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
>> 211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
>> 212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
>> 213                      ELSE
>> 214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT
>> 215                        PERFORM 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC
>> 216                      END-IF
   217                    END-IF
   218                END-IF
   219            END-PERFORM.
   220

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 407-414 show the over-limit IF/ELSE ends before the expiration IF begins, so the expiration check always runs after the over-limit check whatever its result; record-found is implied by the enclosing read branch."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 11 defines ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE as PIC X(10), a 10-character alphanumeric field."},{"clause":"given[2]","supported":false,"reason":"Line 16 shows DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS is PIC X(26), but the claim that only its first 10 characters are compared comes from the (1:10) reference on CBTRN02C line 414, which is not cited for this clause."},{"clause":"given[3]","supported":false,"reason":"Line 6 only shows that ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS exists; the cited line cannot establish that validation never checks it."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 414 continues when the expiration date is >= ORIG-TS(1:10), and the ELSE branch at line 416 handles the less-than case; both sides are alphanumeric, so this is a character comparison."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 417 moves 103 to WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON in the ELSE branch, which unconditionally overwrites any earlier value such as 102."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 418-419 move 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION' to WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC, which overwrites any earlier description."},{"clause":"then[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 211-216 post only when the fail reason is 0; otherwise they add 1 to WS-REJECT-COUNT and perform 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC."}]}
